tldr: NVIDIA's open Nemotron family picked up its first defense-sector customer in June, when Palantir built a secure-environment product on Nemotron models for US government agencies. In July, NVIDIA paired the same family with LangChain's Deep Agents harness and claimed benchmark-leading agent performance at lower cost than closed models.
whats_new: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Embed ranks #1 overall on the Retrieval Embedding Benchmark (RTEB), extending the family's claims from LLM inference and agent orchestration into embeddings.
why_it_matters: Three separate Nemotron sub-models now have public performance claims (secure deployment, agent-harness cost/perf, retrieval benchmark) — worth a look if you're sourcing an open alternative to closed-model APIs for agent or RAG infrastructure.

status.detail: Nemotron is accumulating adoption and benchmark claims across separate product lines (LLM, agent harness tuning, embeddings) rather than centering on one release.

beats.headline: Palantir builds a secure-environment product on Nemotron for US agencies
beats.summary: First public proof point of a defense-sector customer picking the open Nemotron models over closed alternatives.

beats.headline: LangChain tunes its Deep Agents harness specifically for Nemotron 3 Ultra
beats.summary: NVIDIA claims benchmark-leading agent performance at lower cost than top closed models on the most widely adopted orchestration harness.

beats.headline: Nemotron 3 Embed ranks #1 overall on RTEB
beats.summary: A third Nemotron sub-model tops a public retrieval benchmark, extending the family's reach into embeddings for agentic retrieval.

open_questions: Do independent benchmarks (outside NVIDIA's and its partners' own posts) confirm the Deep Agents harness cost/performance claim?
Does Palantir's Nemotron deployment expand to other agencies or stay a single showcase?
How does Nemotron 3 Embed's RTEB rank hold up against incumbent embedding providers on your own retrieval corpus, not just the public leaderboard?
take_for_builders: If you're evaluating embedding models for agentic RAG, benchmark Nemotron 3 Embed against your current provider on your own corpus before switching on RTEB rank alone — all three data points so far are vendor- or partner-published, not independently verified.
